decision.thought: Staraptor outspeeds Duraludon. Banded Reckless isn't boosted on Close Combat, but it's still super effective into Steel/Dragon and should nearly OHKO or OHKO it before it can fire off Draco or Flash Cannon.
decision.notes: Opp lead Duraludon (Steel/Dragon, likely Draco Meteor/Flash Cannon/Body Press/Stealth Rock or Dragon Tail). Staraptor is Choice Band locked into whatever it clicks. Mudsdale and Metagross are solid Steel checks.

decision.thought: Staraptor is locked into a resisted Close Combat and has dropped defenses, so it's a sitting duck for Dedenne's Electric moves. Mudsdale is immune to Electric, so it blanks Nuzzle, Thunderbolt and Volt Switch. It also threatens a big Heavy Slam back.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon (lead, switched out), Dedenne (69%, CC'd). Dedenne likely Nuzzle/Super Fang/Tbolt/Volt Switch/Recover; Mudsdale walls it, and Heavy Slam hits it SE. Keep Staraptor healthy for later cleaning. Metagross resists Dragon if Duraludon comes in on Mudsdale.

decision.thought: Dedenne can't touch Mudsdale, and STAB Earthquake is super effective on it. It also hits a Duraludon switch-in super effectively, so this is the strongest click either way.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon (lead, switched out), Dedenne (69%, has Nuzzle). EQ beats both. Watch for Flying/Levitate switch-ins, then use Heavy Slam or Stone Edge. Keep Band Staraptor healthy for cleaning. Metagross resists Dragon if Duraludon appears.

decision.thought: Tropius is immune to Earthquake, but Stone Edge hits its Flying typing super effectively. Mudsdale's 125 base Attack should take a big chunk even with the 80% accuracy. Stamina also lets Mudsdale soak whatever Tropius throws back.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon (lead, switched out, weak to EQ), Dedenne 69% (has Nuzzle), Tropius (Grass/Flying, immune to EQ; use Stone Edge, or Staraptor Brave Bird). Save Tera Steel. Keep Band Staraptor healthy for cleaning.

decision.thought: Stone Edge just took 48% off Tropius, so another one leaves it in easy KO range or finishes it with a crit. Mudsdale can soak the Leech Seed chip with Leftovers, so I'm keeping Band Staraptor safe for the late game.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon (lead, switched out, weak to EQ/Heavy Slam resisted), Dedenne 69% (Nuzzle), Tropius 63% (Leech Seed; Grass/Flying, 2HKO'd by Stone Edge). Mudsdale seeded. Save Tera Steel. Keep Band Staraptor healthy for cleaning; Brave Bird finishes Tropius if needed.

decision.thought: Tropius can't Protect twice in a row reliably, so Stone Edge goes in now for big super-effective damage.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon (lead, switched out), Dedenne 69% (Nuzzle), Tropius 74% (Leech Seed, Protect; Grass/Flying). Mudsdale seeded, Stamina ability. Save Tera Steel. Keep Band Staraptor healthy for cleaning; Brave Bird finishes Tropius if needed.

decision.thought: Duraludon is weak to Ground, and 125 base Attack Earthquake should take a big chunk off that frail special side. Mudsdale's bulk lets it take a Draco Meteor, and Stamina's Defense boost punishes Body Press.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon (no moves seen yet, likely Draco/Flash Cannon/Body Press/Thunderbolt/SR), Dedenne 69% (Nuzzle), Tropius 74% (Leech Seed, Protect; Grass/Flying, immune to EQ and pivots in on it). Mudsdale is seeded. If Tropius keeps coming in on EQ, go to Stone Edge or bring in Staraptor for Brave Bird. Save Tera Steel. Keep Band Staraptor healthy for cleaning.

decision.thought: Mudsdale is at 18% and seeded, so it's nearly spent. Last Earthquake did 57% to a 58% Duraludon, so a high roll takes the KO. Even if Mudsdale goes down, we get a free switch into our real threats.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon 58% -2 SpA (Draco Meteor seen; faster than Mudsdale), Dedenne 69% (Nuzzle), Tropius 74% (Leech Seed, Protect; walls EQ). Metagross resists Duraludon's Steel/Dragon and its EQ kills it. Staraptor Brave Bird for Tropius. Tera still unused (Mudsdale Steel); consider saving it for a better mon.

decision.thought: Mudsdale is at 12% and seeded, so it's on its last legs. Stone Edge is super effective on Tropius and should chunk it before Mudsdale goes down, which sets up Staraptor to finish.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon 58% -2 SpA (Draco Meteor; faster than Mudsdale), Dedenne 69% (Nuzzle), Tropius 86% (Leech Seed, Protect; immune to EQ). Mudsdale is fodder now. Next: Staraptor Brave Bird to clean Tropius; Metagross vs Duraludon. Tera still unused; save it (Staraptor Flying or Metagross Water).

decision.thought: Staraptor comes in to take on Tropius. It outspeeds, and a Choice Band Reckless Brave Bird hits for super effective damage and should OHKO the 86% Tropius.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon 58% -2 SpA (Draco Meteor), Dedenne 69% (Nuzzle), Tropius 86% (Leech Seed, Protect, Air Slash). Mudsdale fainted. Plan: Staraptor Brave Bird Tropius (watch for Protect), then pivot out vs Duraludon to Metagross. Tera unused.

decision.thought: Band Reckless Brave Bird is a 4x-boosted super-effective nuke on Tropius at 86%, so it should be a clean OHKO without spending Tera. If they Protect, we just click it again.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon 58% -2 SpA (Draco Meteor), Dedenne 69% (Nuzzle), Tropius 86% (Leech Seed, Protect, Air Slash). Mudsdale fainted. Staraptor is Choice Banded: locked into Brave Bird after this. Pivot to Metagross if Duraludon comes in. Tera still unused.

decision.thought: Dedenne outspeeds Staraptor and threatens it with Electric, and a resisted Brave Bird may not finish it. Metagross comes in to shrug off Fairy hits and threatens a super-effective Heavy Slam, while keeping Tera in reserve.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon 58% -2 SpA (Draco Meteor), Dedenne 65% no item (Cheek Pouch, Nuzzle), Tropius 86% (Leech Seed, Protect, Air Slash). Mudsdale fainted. Staraptor Banded at 79%; Brave Bird does ~62% to Dedenne. Metagross: Heavy Slam Dedenne, get Stealth Rock up when possible. Tera unused.

decision.thought: Earthquake is super effective on Dedenne and should finish it from 65%. It also punishes a Duraludon switch-in with super-effective damage.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon 58% (Draco Meteor), Dedenne 65% (Nuzzle, Thunderbolt, no item), Tropius 86% (Leech Seed, Protect, Air Slash). Mudsdale fainted. Staraptor Banded at 79%. Metagross ~70%: EQ vs Dedenne/Duraludon, Heavy Slam vs Tropius. Still want Stealth Rock up. Tera unused.

decision.thought: Quagsire is a slow, passive wall that can't threaten much right now, so this is the window to finally get Stealth Rock up. Rocks hit Tropius for super-effective damage and chip Duraludon every time it switches in.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon 58% (Draco Meteor), Tropius 86% (Leech Seed, Protect, Air Slash), Quagsire 100% (likely Unaware/Water Absorb, Recover/Toxic/EQ). Dedenne fainted. Metagross paralyzed ~71%. Arboliva is a good answer to Quagsire (Grass hits Water). Staraptor Banded 79%. Tera unused.

decision.thought: Quagsire is probably Unaware, so boosts don't matter and chip damage does. Knock Off takes away its item, likely Leftovers, and deals solid damage. Metagross is paralyzed and has already set rocks, so it can afford to take a hit for this.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon 58% (Draco Meteor), Tropius 86% (Leech Seed/Protect/Air Slash), Quagsire (Ice Beam, likely Unaware; watch for EQ/Toxic/Recover). Rocks up on opp side. Metagross is paralyzed and mostly used up after rocks. Arboliva can Sub+Seed Quagsire (watch Ice Beam). Regieleki can clean Tropius. Staraptor is Banded. Tera unused.

decision.thought: Metagross is at 16% and paralyzed, so it's slower and one more Earthquake finishes it. Earthquake is our strongest hit on Quagsire, so we get chip damage in first. Then Arboliva comes in for free.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon 58% (Draco Meteor), Tropius 86% (Leech Seed/Protect/Air Slash), Quagsire (Ice Beam/EQ, no item now, likely Unaware; outspeeds paralyzed Metagross). Rocks up on opp side. Plan: Arboliva Sub+Seed Quagsire next. Regieleki cleans Tropius. Staraptor is Banded. Tera unused.

decision.thought: Arboliva walls Quagsire: its Grass typing takes Earthquake at half and Ice Beam neutral. Sub plus Leech Seed farms it while Harvest Sitrus keeps us healthy. Quagsire's likely Unaware ability doesn't matter since we aren't boosting.
decision.notes: Opp: Duraludon 58% (Draco Meteor), Tropius 86% (Leech Seed/Protect/Air Slash), Quagsire 74% (Ice Beam/EQ, item removed, likely Unaware). Rocks on opp side. Plan: Arboliva Sub/Seed/Hyper Voice vs Quag; Regieleki cleans Tropius; Staraptor Banded CC for Duraludon. Tera unused (Arboliva tera Water option).
